title: Technical Discovery: Checkout, Webhooks & Stripe Integration

utterances.speaker: Jordan Blake
utterances.text: Hello Frank, good to connect. Let's discuss your subscription billing setup for SwiftParts Auto Guild.

utterances.speaker: Frank Miller
utterances.text: Hey Jordan. Right now our auto repair shops have to mail us paper checks or send manual Zelle payments to stay listed. It's a logistical nightmare. We need automated online credit card processing with Stripe for annual $450 membership plans.

utterances.speaker: Jordan Blake
utterances.text: Understood. Brilliant Directories has native Stripe integration. When shops pay their annual fee, we want instant account provisioning and automated renewal webhooks.

utterances.speaker: Frank Miller
utterances.text: Yes! And when the annual renewal succeeds, they need an automated branded PDF receipt emailed with our tax identification number and their business name on it.

utterances.speaker: Jordan Blake
utterances.text: We can leverage the built-in email templates and webhook listeners for invoice.payment_succeeded to trigger that immediately. What about failed payments or expired cards?

utterances.speaker: Frank Miller
utterances.text: If a renewal card declines, give them a 7-day grace period with automated reminder emails before changing their directory listing status to inactive.
